about: Coach-facing wording Christian has APPROVED for parts of a game the renderer otherwise cannot say: primary-event conditions (register V4-V6) and information rules (V16-V22), and later the modifier criterion and termination (V8c, V8d). His order of 14 October 2026, Step 4 component 3: 'Enable accurate coach-facing communication of scoring conditions and information rules, using approved language.' An entry is used only when it carries approvedBy with who, a date, his words verbatim and the communication standard it was reviewed under; the loader ignores any other entry and a data test fails it. Wording is data, so no sport term enters universal code. Starts EMPTY on 14 October 2026: until he approves a sentence, every such field is withheld and the activity is refused at communication rather than paraphrased.

entryShape.id: a stable id for the entry
entryShape.covers: [{ row: 'V4'|'V5'|'V6'|'V8c'|'V8d'|'V16'..'V22', match: { equals: <JSON value> } | { refersToOwnCondition: true } }] - every cover must hold on one element for the entry to apply
entryShape.sentence: the approved sentence; {slot} names a slot
entryShape.slots: { slotName: { field: '<field of the same element>' } } - filled only from cited game values
entryShape.section: Set up | Players | How it works | How to score | What to watch
